title: A clip landing where another sits does the same thing however it got there
goal: When a clip arrives on a spot of the timeline that already holds something, the app now does one of three different things depending on how it arrived: a file dropped from Finder covers what is there, a pasted clip or an Option-dragged copy goes up onto a new track, and a clip you drag along is refused with 'no room'. Someone who learns one gesture is wrong about the next. Pick one rule with the user and make every way in follow it.
notes: Found by the daily digest 2026-10-06 from the docs and the audits, not by running anything new. File drop overwrites: docs/design/video-audio.md 'Let go on the TIMELINE instead', Overwrite by default, Command inserts. Paste goes up a track: queue/audits/2026-10-05-paste-a-clip-at-the-playhead.json rough ('this one puts the copy on a new track over it when the track is busy'). Option-drag goes up a track: queue/audits/2026-10-05-option-drag-copies-a-clip.json, whose evaluate question already asks the user this for Option-drag alone. Dragging a clip is refused: queue/audits/2026-10-06-refused-drop-says-why.json ('no room on V2') and 2026-10-05-several-clips-change-track. Add Media at Playhead lands on a free track or a new one on top (2026-10-05-add-media-at-playhead). Premiere overwrites in every one of these cases. The landing rule lives in ClipLanding.swift and the paste rule reuses Add Media's (a48ef47a), so one rule is a small change once chosen.
acceptance: The user has answered the card on this task, and the answer is written into the video design docs as the one landing rule
Dropping a file, pasting a clip, Option-dragging a copy, dragging a clip (one or several) and Add Media at Playhead onto an occupied spot all do what the card chose, at Next defaults
Command still inserts on a drop, as the design doc says, unless the card says otherwise
A walk at Next defaults lands a clip on an occupied spot each of those ways and photographs the result, and the audit says what happened to the clip that was there
